title: Completion of unresolved defect mappings
method: Current main.tex and handbook.sty were traversed through literal input/include/showcalculus references; comments and dynamic parameterized paths were not treated as ordinary inclusions. The traversal reached 841 files. Named inactive former repairs were compared with that route.

Initial 14,780-line v1 source at Git commit 676d170c115e7cfe2fde73229e2258a73b6baf27 supplied locating leads only. Its numeric coordinates and historical fixed/obsolete dispositions were not treated as current evidence.

Every row preserves the exact original repair and acceptance text, separates components, and supplies current text intervals read and SHA-256 digests. Searches support locating/absence claims but are not silently promoted to a full proof review.
No manuscript/source/register files were edited. No tests, builds, renders, acquisitions, regeneration or commits were performed. Only these two new inventory outputs were written.
interpretation: repair_present means the scoped named source repair is present; it is not a writing percentage or whole-book acceptance.

policy_conflict identifies a literal old prescription incompatible with the currently selected calculus or presentation interface; it does not excuse retaining a known mathematical falsehood. Source corrections remain required at their point of use.

R-018 has a complete direct proof but not the specifically demanded induction; S-026 now registers the glyph but its old bounded-quantifier prescription requires correction. Their partial outcomes describe that exact component split.
production_evidence_missing_or_stale identifies unavailable current output acceptance, not a claim that the current output has been generated and failed.
